CorpseOneIntro: ^You stare at a blue rag. It's draped over the outline of a someone.
^How is this guy sleeping down here?
^Are you simple? He's clearly faking it. Just a lazy guy.

s: ^"Ah, I see. It must be normal to take naps down here."
^E-Let him sleep. He must have had a rough day.

speakwithhim: ^Give it up. Nothing to gain here.
^Curious behavior to lie perfectly still under a blanket like this. Perhaps he requires assistance?
^The goblin looks at you with a furrowed brow.

s: ^E-I should let him sleep. He must have had a rough day.

c-6: ^He nods and gives you a serious look.
^"Sir. The Cleric is talking to you."
^"Damn. You know, for an alive guy, he's very still, silent, and cold."

g-0: ^If you wish to commune with the corpse in any meaningful way, I suggest Speak with Dead.

s: ^E-I should stop messing with the corpse.

checkUnder: ^Underneath you find the cold corpse of a human.
^Looking over him you find... uh... hair. Pale skin. He's got a beard too.
^His complexion shows nearly no decay. Most likely under the effect of a preserving spell.
^Yeah, this guy looks fresh. Like he could just sit up and talk to you.
^His sons miss him and despise him.
^He does not wish to partake in death.
^The DC (Difficulty Class) of a Dice Choice is determined by how challenging that roll will be for you.

s: ^Like, I've been trained to handle them. Right?

g-0: ^You do not have the training to handle them, no.
^But of course, you do have the skills to draw basic conclusions. So go ahead.
^Heh. You know exactly what you're doing.
^Formal training is for people without true talent.

s: ^Oh. Right. I mostly dealt with paperwork.
^A hero is not afraid of getting his hands bloody.
^Got it. I'm a master of corpsecraft.

g-1: ^There's something strange here. We must look closer.
g-2: ^Signs of being either a hard worker or a careless worker litter his skin.
^Make sure to check the back as well.
g-3: ^The moment you touch it, black veins appear over its skin.
^A feeling of impending doom comes over you. Your stomach drops.
^Necrotic energies. Let go of the damn corpse!
g-4: ^The moment you let go, the pain subsides.
^The dark marks on its skin disappear as quickly as they showed up.
^The goblin looks over to you with a concerned expression.
^"This is why I don't deal with corpses."
^What a horrific spell. This corpse is cursed by something wicked beyond your powers.
^They should at least have a sign up.
^Like, 'don't touch the dead, they're full of black magic'.
^You slowly cover up the corpse once more.
^You need to look deeper into this.
^There's something strange here. This is no regular Gentle Repose.
^Look close, but do not move the corpse.
g-5: ^Signs of being either a hard worker or a careless worker litter his skin.
^Cause of death appears to be not directly visible.
^Considering his age and the shape of his body, this man most likely died of a common disease or internal failure.
g-6: ^Unless you're willing to start cutting, that's all you'll get.
g-7: ^There's also a marking on the right leg. A circle with a cross inside it.
^You recall: that is the marking of PR. 'Potential Revivification'.

s: ^Oh. Right. This guy can be revived?

g-8: ^Seems so. He most likely died during care, and was granted immediate Gentle Repose.
^However, he clearly did not have an RF. A Revive Fund. Nor did he have family members with enough ready cash.
^Or perhaps he was just an unlikable fellow. Who knows?
g-9: ^You cover up the corpse once more.
^A weak goblin, cannot stand the presence of death. Understandable.
^The goblin is not used to corpsecraft. Good.

s: ^.LL_TheCorpseCanBeRevivied==1-So I could cast Revivify on this guy?
^.LL_CorpseOne_WickedSpell==1-What the hell kind of magic is cast on this thing?
^E-I should stop bothering the corpse now.

c-24: ^Although the question is more akin to: why should you?
^A third level spell slot is a valuable resource. Why waste it on some blue collar corpse?
^If you can - always save a life. Or bring it back.
^Ignoring the fact that you cannot simply spend your power on any old fool...
^There are also a million outcomes to a resurrection that could lead to a negative outcome in the world.
^Perhaps in your foolish alignment system. But not in reality.
c-25: ^It appears like a Gentle Repose at first glance. But that necrotic energy...
^A guess would be an advanced animation ritual. But you have no knowledge of such dark spells.
^Whatever it is, do not touch it again.
c-26: ^As long as he doesn't wake up, or anything...?
^If you can suffer the loss of moral integrity.
^Moral integrity? It's a dead guy. He's not gonna need his stuff, obviously?
^Not like the guy will complain. But don't go around talking about it too loud, okay?
^It would be dishonorable. Only take that which you need for your QUEST.
^Grave-robbing is frowned upon by some, even in these enlightened times.
^Either way, you will not get in any trouble. No one will know.
c-27: ^His hands are calloused. He's built like a sarcophagus.
^This is a dead working man. The type to spend his whole life toiling away for nothing.
^That's a sad way to view a life of valuable hard work.
c-28: ^This is a morgue. A lichhouse. Clearly.
^Corpses are kept on cooling in places like this, before cremation or burials.
^The apples make it hard to believe, but... yeah.
^Must've been one hell of a deal to put those two together.
c-30: ^The corpse is filled with the animated spirit of whoever he was in life.
^"I don't think this guy's got anything interesting to say, Cleric."

s: ^.Snell==1-"I don't know, Snell. Maybe he saw something about the tea shop?"
^"Hold on, that wasn't a question, was it?"
^"Hm. Let's see here, what should I ask...?"

c-0: ^"I did not," the corpse whispers out.
c-2: ^The corpse waits for your next question.

s: ^"What were you voting in the election?"
^"Tell me everything you know about the tea shop. Or... what you knew."
^"Didn't you have anyone who could pay for your resurrection?"
^"That's a great choice. I'm also a Nationalist!"
^"Well, I'll be voting for the Freestriders, obviously."
^"You fool! You're clearly working class. You should vote for the Azgalists!"
^DC11 int-"I'll be voting for myself. I'll be your Arcanist ruler. A wizard-king. Sounds good, huh?"
^"Okay. Well. I don't care." (Just be apolitical. In a neutral way.)
^DC17 con-(Feel ashamed.) "I'm Agrarian. Just a farm boy. Looking to return to bare basics, you know?"

g-0: ^You get no response from the corpse.

s: ^(Sigh.) "What, how, when and who do you know, related to or surrounding the general topic, of the tea shop either exploding and/or anything else that happens there?"

g-0: ^"The dwarves go there. It's a rebel place. Bad place."
^"I don't let my boys go near, I won't raise no stinking Azgalist."
^"That Bird is a rotten apple too. Just in case you wanted to know."

c-37: ^"Too expensive. The Azgalists are to blame."
c-38: ^"The docks. For twenty years. Many different companies. The dock switched hands many times."
^And it'll surely switch around even more in the future.
c-39: ^"They would not dare leave me dead."
^He has been down here for a long time.
^They are not coming to save him.
^How disrespectful of his sons to leave him here!

^Not a bad motto, but... he probably got a bit swindled considering where he ended up.

g-12: ^The corpse stops being animated, and returns to its still state.

s: ^.Snell==1-"I have a feeling it's a good corpse."

c-50: ^"Well. Good luck on your lottery corpse."

g-15: ^You touch a finger to his forehead, to his chest, and to his left wrist.
^The three hundred coins turn to light in the air over his chest.
g-16: ^Not the easiest Revivify. Gentle Repose keeps the body from decomposing, but it's still cold. And the soul is far gone.
^The faint outline of an esoteric visage appears around the corpse.
g-17: ^He mutters to himself and then looks at you.

s: ^"You're alright now, citizen. I've revived you."

g-18: ^The man slowly gets up from the cold block.
^"I feel... fucking awful. What did you do to me, you cunt?"
^This is why you do not spend third level spell slots and three hundred crowns on random old men.
g-19: ^"I said, what did you- ugh...!" he groans and steps away, dropping the tarp.
g-20: ^"Yeah, I can <shake>fucking</shake> tell! Gah..." he groans again and holds his head.
^"Where's Rollo? That fucking boy... he knows I've got insurance! I paid to be brought back with clothes, damn it!"

s: ^"You've been out for a few weeks, I think."
^"I paid for your resurrection, you ungrateful prick!"

^.Snell==1-"You think he was weird, because of the esoteric magic stuff?"
